name: Vigonvita Life Sciences Co., Ltd.
summary: Vigonvita Life Sciences Co., Ltd. is a Suzhou-based biopharmaceutical company, incorporated in 2013, that discovers, develops and commercializes small molecule drugs in neuropsychiatry, reproductive health and viral infection. Its pipeline includes LV232 for depression, TPN171 for erectile dysfunction, VV116 for respiratory syncytial virus and COVID-19, TPN102 for epilepsy and VV119 for psychiatric disorders, along with several other candidates.
